name: dr
description: Disaster recovery: promote a standby, fence the old primary, run drills, and install the systemd units DR needs.
author: nself

actions.fence: Fence the old primary so it cannot accept writes
actions.install-units: Install the systemd units DR uses

notes: This is a CLI-proxy plugin, not a service plugin: it has no port, no HTTP server, and no database tables. `nself plugin install dr` must place the built nself-dr binary at ~/.nself/plugins/bin/nself-dr, where internal/plugin/router.go's ProxyCommand execs it for `nself dr <args>` with stdio inherited. Extracted from the CLI core under CLI-R11.
